method.public_headline: POB novelty × square-root(reference consensus); documented risk is excluded

pob.text: It happened in the thirtieth year[a], in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, while I was among the exiles by the Kebar River, the heavens were opened[b], and I saw visions of God.

spob.text: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, I was among the exiles beside the Kebar River.[a] The heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
public_domain_references.web: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
public_domain_references.asv: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, as I [was] among the captives by the river of Chebar, [that] the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
public_domain_references.brenton: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, that I was in the midst of the captivity by the river of Chobar; and the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

pob.text: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—[a]

spob.text: The date was the fifth day of the month, during the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s exile.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
public_domain_references.web: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
public_domain_references.asv: In the fifth [day] of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
public_domain_references.kjv: In the fifth [day] of the month, which [was] the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
public_domain_references.brenton: On the fifth day of the month; this was the fifth year of the captivity of king Joakim.

pob.text: the word of Yahweh came indeed to Ezekiel son of Buzi[a], the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the Kebar River[c][b], and there the hand of Yahweh came upon him.

spob.text: The word of Yahweh certainly came to Ezekiel son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Babylonians[a] by the Kebar River.[b] There the hand of Yahweh came upon him.

public_domain_references.bsb: the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.
public_domain_references.asv: the word of Jehovah came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of Jehovah was there upon him.
public_domain_references.kjv: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the word of the Lord came to Jezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans, by the river of Chobar; and the hand of the Lord was upon me.

pob.text: And I looked[a], and behold, a storm wind was coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing continually, and brightness all around it; and from its midst was something like the appearance of glowing metal[c][b], from the midst of the fire.

spob.text: I looked, and there before me was a violent windstorm[a] coming from the north—a great cloud with fire continually flashing[c] and brightness all around it. From deep within it—from within the fire—came something that looked like glowing metal.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,
public_domain_references.web: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
public_domain_references.asv: And I looked, and, behold, a stormy wind came out of the north, a great cloud, with a fire infolding itself, and a brightness round about it, and out of the midst thereof as it were glowing metal, out of the midst of the fire.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness [was] about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I looked, and, behold, a sweeping wind came from the north, and a great cloud on it, and [there was] brightness round about it, and gleaming fire, and in the midst of it as it were the appearance of amber in the midst of the fire, and brightness in it.

pob.text: And from within it came the likeness of four living creatures[b][a]. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man.

spob.text: From inside it came what looked like four living creatures. This was what they looked like: they had a human-like form.

public_domain_references.bsb: and within it was the form of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: They had a human form,
public_domain_references.web: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
public_domain_references.asv: And out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man;
public_domain_references.kjv: Also out of the midst thereof [came] the likeness of four living creatures. And this [was] their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
public_domain_references.brenton: And in the midst as it were the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; the likeness of a man was upon them.

pob.text: Each had four faces, and each of them had four wings.

spob.text: Each one had four faces and four wings.

public_domain_references.bsb: but each had four faces and four wings.
public_domain_references.web: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
public_domain_references.asv: and every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.
public_domain_references.kjv: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
public_domain_references.brenton: And each one [had] four faces, and each one [had] four wings.

pob.text: Their legs were straight[a], and the soles of their feet were like the sole of a calf’s foot[b], and they gleamed like the appearance of polished bronze.

spob.text: Their legs were straight. The bottoms of their feet were like a calf’s hoof,[a] and they gleamed like polished bronze.

public_domain_references.bsb: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.
public_domain_references.web: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
public_domain_references.asv: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished brass.
public_domain_references.kjv: And their feet [were] straight feet; and the sole of their feet [was] like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
public_domain_references.brenton: And their legs were straight; and their feet were winged, and [there were] sparks, like gleaming brass, and their wings were light.

pob.text: And they had human hands under their wings on their four sides[b][a]; and the four of them had their faces and their wings.

spob.text: Under their wings, on their four sides, they had human hands. All four of them also had faces and wings.

public_domain_references.bsb: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,
public_domain_references.web: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:
public_domain_references.asv: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings [thus]:
public_domain_references.kjv: And [they had] the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the hand of a man was under their wings on their four sides.

pob.text: Their wings were joined[a], each to her sister. As they moved, they did not turn[b]; each one went straight ahead.

spob.text: Each creature’s wings were joined to the wings of the other creatures. As the creatures moved, each one went straight ahead without turning.

public_domain_references.bsb: and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.
public_domain_references.web: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
public_domain_references.asv: their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
public_domain_references.kjv: Their wings [were] joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the faces of them four turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

pob.text: As for the likeness of their faces: each had a human face; the four had a lion’s face on the right side[a], the four had an ox’s face on the left side, and the four had an eagle’s face.

spob.text: This is what their faces looked like: Each of the four had a human face. On the right side, each had a lion’s face, and on the left side, each had an ox’s face. Each also had an eagle’s face.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.
public_domain_references.web: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.
public_domain_references.asv: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man; and they four had the face of a lion on the right side; and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four had also the face of an eagle.
public_domain_references.kjv: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the likeness of their faces was the face of a man, and the face of a lion on the right to the four; and the face of a calf on the left to the four; and the face of an eagle to the four.

pob.text: And their faces and their wings were separated above[a]; each had two joined to one another[b], and two covering their bodies.

spob.text: Their faces and wings were separated above.[a] Each creature had two wings joined to one another, and two wings covered its body.

public_domain_references.bsb: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.
public_domain_references.web: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
public_domain_references.asv: And their faces and their wings were separate above; two [wings] of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thus [were] their faces: and their wings [were] stretched upward; two [wings] of every one [were] joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the four had their wings spread out above; each one [had] two joined to one another, and two covered their bodies.

pob.text: And each one went straight ahead[a]. Wherever the spirit was to go, they went[b]; they did not turn as they went.

spob.text: Each one moved straight ahead. Wherever the spirit[a] was going, they went. They did not turn as they moved.

public_domain_references.bsb: Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
public_domain_references.web: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
public_domain_references.asv: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; they turned not when they went.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; [and] they turned not when they went.
public_domain_references.brenton: And each one went straight forward: wherever the spirit was going they went, and turned not back.

pob.text: And as for the likeness of the living creatures[a], their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches; it was moving about among the living creatures, and the fire had brightness[c][b], and from the fire lightning was coming forth.

spob.text: The living creatures looked like burning coals, like torches. It[a] was moving among them. The fire shone brightly, and lightning kept flashing from it.

public_domain_references.bsb: In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
public_domain_references.web: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.
public_domain_references.asv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches: [the fire] went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
public_domain_references.kjv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance [was] like burning coals of fire, [and] like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
public_domain_references.brenton: And in the midst of the living creatures [there was] an appearance as of burning coals of fire, as an appearance of lamps turning among the living creatures; and the brightness of fire, and out of the fire came forth lightning.

pob.text: And the living creatures were running back and forth[a], like the appearance of lightning.

spob.text: The living creatures raced back and forth like lightning.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.
public_domain_references.web: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
public_domain_references.asv: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

pob.text: As I looked at the living creatures[a], behold, one wheel was on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of their four faces.

spob.text: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw this: on the ground beside each creature was a wheel.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
public_domain_references.web: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
public_domain_references.asv: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold, one wheel upon the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I looked, and, behold, the four [had each] one wheel on the ground near the living creatures.

pob.text: The appearance of the wheels and their workmanship was like the gleam of beryl[a], and the four of them had the same likeness; and their appearance and their workmanship were as if a wheel were within a wheel.

spob.text: The four wheels all looked alike. They gleamed like beryl,[a] and each looked and was constructed as if a wheel were within a wheel.

public_domain_references.bsb: The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.
public_domain_references.web: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
public_domain_references.asv: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto a beryl: and they four had one likeness; and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
public_domain_references.kjv: The appearance of the wheels and their work [was] like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work [was] as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the appearance of the wheels was as the appearance of beryl: and the four had one likeness: and their work was as it were a wheel in a wheel.

pob.text: As they went[a], they went in any of their four directions; they did not turn as they went.

spob.text: They moved in any of the four directions[a] without turning.

public_domain_references.bsb: As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.
public_domain_references.web: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
public_domain_references.asv: When they went, they went in their four directions: they turned not when they went.
public_domain_references.kjv: When they went, they went upon their four sides: [and] they turned not when they went.
public_domain_references.brenton: They went on their four sides: they turned not as they went;

pob.text: As for their rims[a], they were high and fearsome, and the rims of all four were full of eyes all around.

spob.text: Their rims were high and frightening. The rim of each of the four wheels was full of eyes all the way around.

public_domain_references.bsb: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
public_domain_references.web: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
public_domain_references.asv: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and they four had their rims full of eyes round about.
public_domain_references.kjv: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings [were] full of eyes round about them four.
public_domain_references.brenton: neither did their backs [turn]: and they were high: and I beheld them, and the backs of them four were full of eyes round about.

pob.text: When the living creatures moved[a], the wheels moved beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth[b], the wheels were lifted up.

spob.text: When the living creatures[a] moved, the wheels moved alongside them. When the living creatures were lifted off the ground, the wheels were lifted up too.

public_domain_references.bsb: So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
public_domain_references.web: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
public_domain_references.asv: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
public_domain_references.brenton: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures lifted themselves off the earth, the wheels were lifted off.

pob.text: Wherever the spirit wanted to go[a], they went there; and the wheels were lifted up alongside them[c][b], because the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

spob.text: Wherever the spirit wanted them to go, they went. The wheels were lifted up beside them, because the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
public_domain_references.web: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
public_domain_references.asv: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went; thither was the spirit to go: and the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
public_domain_references.kjv: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither [was their] spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature [was] in the wheels.
public_domain_references.brenton: Wherever the cloud happened to be, there was the spirit ready to go: the wheels went and were lifted up with them; because the spirit of life was in the wheels.

pob.text: When they went[a], these went; and when they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up from above the earth, the wheels were lifted up alongside them[c][b], for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

spob.text: When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved with them. When the creatures stood still, the wheels also stood still. When the creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up alongside them.[b] This happened because the spirit[a] of the living creatures was in the wheels.

public_domain_references.bsb: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
public_domain_references.web: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
public_domain_references.asv: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
public_domain_references.kjv: When those went, [these] went; and when those stood, [these] stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature [was] in the wheels.
public_domain_references.brenton: When those went, [the wheels] went; and when those stood, [the wheels] stood; and when those lifted themselves off the earth, they were lifted off with them: for the spirit of life was in the wheels.

pob.text: And above the heads of the living creatures there was the likeness of an expanse[a], like the appearance of awe-inspiring ice[b], stretched out above their heads from above.

spob.text: Above the heads of the living creatures was something resembling an expanse, stretched out high over them. Its appearance was like awe-inspiring ice.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
public_domain_references.web: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
public_domain_references.asv: And over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of a firmament, like the terrible crystal to look upon, stretched forth over their heads above.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature [was] as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the likeness over the heads of the living creatures was as a firmament, as the appearance of crystal, spread out over their wings above.

pob.text: And under the expanse their wings were straight[a], each one toward her sister. Each had two covering them[b], and each had two covering their bodies.

spob.text: Beneath the expanse, the creatures’ wings were straight, each toward the other.[a] Each creature had two wings covering it and two covering its body.

public_domain_references.bsb: And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.
public_domain_references.web: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
public_domain_references.asv: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two which covered on this side, and every one had two which covered on that side, their bodies.
public_domain_references.kjv: And under the firmament [were] their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
public_domain_references.brenton: And their wings were spread out under the firmament, reaching one to the other; two [wings] to each, covering their bodies.

pob.text: And I heard the sound of their wings[a], like the sound of many waters, like the sound of the Almighty when they went, a sound of tumult like the sound of an army camp. When they stood still[b], they lowered their wings.

spob.text: I heard the sound of their wings when they moved. It was like the sound of rushing waters, like the sound of the Almighty[a]—an uproar like an army camp. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

public_domain_references.bsb: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
public_domain_references.web: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
public_domain_references.asv: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of a host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I heard the sound of their wings when they went, as the sound of much water: and when they stood, their wings were let down.

pob.text: And there was a sound from above the expanse that was over their heads[a]; when they stood still[b], they let down their wings.

spob.text: Then a sound came from above the expanse over their heads.[a] When they stopped moving, they lowered their wings.

public_domain_references.bsb: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
public_domain_references.web: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
public_domain_references.asv: And there was a voice above the firmament that was over their heads: when they stood, they let down their wings.
public_domain_references.kjv: And there was a voice from the firmament that [was] over their heads, when they stood, [and] had let down their wings.
public_domain_references.brenton: And lo! a voice from above the firmament

pob.text: And above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne[a], in appearance like sapphire stone; and above the likeness of the throne was a likeness with the appearance of a man above it.

spob.text: Above the spread-out surface over their heads was something like a throne, looking like sapphire stone.[a] Above the likeness of that throne was a likeness that looked like a man.

public_domain_references.brenton: Now I will pour out mine anger upon thee near at hand, and I will accomplish my wrath on thee: and I will judge thee for thy ways, and recompense upon thee all thine abominations.

pob.text: An end has come; the end has come. It has awakened against you; look, it is coming.

spob.text: The end has come! Yes, the end has come. It has awakened against you. Look—it is coming!

public_domain_references.bsb: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. Behold, it has come!
public_domain_references.web: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.
public_domain_references.asv: An end is come, the end is come; it awaketh against thee; behold, it cometh.
public_domain_references.kjv: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
public_domain_references.brenton: Mine eye shall not spare, nor will I have any mercy: for I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord that smite [thee].

pob.text: Doom has come upon you[a], inhabitant of the land. The time has come; the day is near—panic[b], and not joyful shouting on the mountains.

spob.text: Doom has come to you who live in the land.[a] The time has come, and the day is near—a time of panic, not joyful shouting on the mountains.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Doom has come to you, O inhabitants of the land. The time has come; the day is near; there is panic on the mountains instead of shouts of joy.
public_domain_references.web: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
public_domain_references.asv: Thy doom is come unto thee, O inhabitant of the land: the time is come, the day is near, [a day of] tumult, and not [of] joyful shouting, upon the mountains.
public_domain_references.kjv: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble [is] near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
public_domain_references.brenton: Now the end [is come] to thee, and I will send [judgment] upon thee: and I will take vengeance on thy ways, and will recompense all thine abominations upon thee.

pob.text: Now[a], soon I will pour out my wrath on you, and I will spend my anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways[b], and I will bring all your abominations upon you.

spob.text: Now—very soon—I will pour out my wrath on you, and my anger against you will run its full course. I will judge you for the way you have lived, and I will make you bear the consequences of all your abominations.

public_domain_references.bsb: Very soon I will pour out My wrath upon you and vent My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
public_domain_references.web: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
public_domain_references.asv: Now will I shortly pour out my wrath upon thee, and accomplish mine anger against thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
public_domain_references.brenton: Mine eye shall not spare, nor will I have any mercy: for I will recompense thy way upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

pob.text: My eye will not spare[a], nor will I show pity. I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst. Then you will know that I am Yahweh[c][b], who strikes.

spob.text: I will not look on you with mercy or show you pity. I will bring your own conduct back upon you. Your abominations—your detestable things—will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, who strikes.

public_domain_references.bsb: I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who strikes the blow.
public_domain_references.web: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.
public_domain_references.asv: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will bring upon thee according to thy ways; and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, do smite.
public_domain_references.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations [that] are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD that smiteth.
public_domain_references.brenton: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, the end is come.

pob.text: Look[a], the day! Look, it comes! Doom has gone out; the rod has budded; arrogance has blossomed.

spob.text: Look! The day is coming! Look—it is coming! Doom[a] has broken out. The rod has budded, and arrogance has blossomed.

public_domain_references.bsb: Behold, the day is here! It has come! Doom has gone out, the rod has budded, arrogance has bloomed.
public_domain_references.web: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, the day, behold, it cometh: thy doom is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, the day of the Lord! although the rod has blossomed,

pob.text: Violence has arisen into a rod of wickedness[a]; none of them remains, none of their multitude, none of their wealth[b], and there is no eminence among them.

spob.text: Violence has risen and become a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain. Their great multitude and their wealth will be gone, and nothing prominent will remain among them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Their violence has grown into a rod to punish their wickedness. None of them will remain: none of their multitude, none of their wealth, and nothing of value.
public_domain_references.web: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
public_domain_references.asv: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness; none of them [shall remain], nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth: neither shall there be eminency among them.
public_domain_references.kjv: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them [shall remain], nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither [shall there be] wailing for them.
public_domain_references.brenton: pride has sprung up, and will break the staff of the wicked one, and [that] not with tumult, nor with haste.

pob.text: The time has come[a]; the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice, and let not the seller mourn[b], for wrath is against all her multitude.

spob.text: The time has come; the day is here. The buyer must not celebrate, and the seller must not grieve, because wrath is against all her people.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice and the seller not mourn, for wrath is upon the whole multitude.
public_domain_references.web: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.
public_domain_references.asv: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath [is] upon all the multitude thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: The time is come, behold the day: let not the buyer rejoice, and let not the seller mourn.

pob.text: For the seller will not return to what was sold[a], though they are still alive; for the vision concerning all its multitude will not turn back[e][d][c][b], and no one will strengthen his life in his iniquity.

spob.text: For a seller will not regain what he sold, even if the buyer and seller are both still alive. The vision about the whole population[a] will not be reversed, and no one will make his life secure through his own wrongdoing.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The seller will surely not recover what he sold while both remain alive. For the vision concerning the whole multitude will not be revoked, and because of their iniquity, not one of them will preserve his life.
public_domain_references.web: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
public_domain_references.asv: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they be yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, none shall return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision [is] touching the whole multitude thereof, [which] shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
public_domain_references.brenton: For the buyer shall never again return to the seller, neither shall a man cleave with the eye [of hope] to his life.

pob.text: They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready[a], but no one goes to battle[b], for my wrath is against all her multitude.

spob.text: They have sounded the trumpet and completed all the preparations. Yet no one goes into battle, because my burning anger is against all her people.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes to war, for My wrath is upon the whole multitude.
public_domain_references.web: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.
public_domain_references.asv: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but none goeth to the battle; for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath [is] upon all the multitude thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: Sound ye the trumpet, and pass sentence on all together.

pob.text: The sword is outside[a], and pestilence and famine are inside. Whoever is in the field will die by the sword, and whoever is in the city[b], famine and pestilence will consume him.

spob.text: Outside there is the sword; inside there are plague and famine. Anyone out in the field will die by the sword. Famine and plague will consume anyone in the city.

public_domain_references.bsb: The sword is outside; plague and famine are within. Those in the country will die by the sword, and those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.
public_domain_references.web: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.
public_domain_references.asv: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
public_domain_references.kjv: The sword [is] without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that [is] in the field shall die with the sword; and he that [is] in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
public_domain_references.brenton: [There shall be] war with the sword without, and famine and pestilence within: he that is in the field shall die by the sword; and famine and pestilence shall destroy them that are in the city.

pob.text: And their survivors will escape and be on the mountains[a], like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning[c][b], each one in his iniquity.

spob.text: Those who survive will escape and be in the mountains. There they will be like doves in the valleys,[a] all of them moaning, each one in their own guilt.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The survivors will escape and live in the mountains, moaning like doves of the valley, each for his own iniquity.
public_domain_references.web: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.
public_domain_references.asv: But those of them that escape shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, every one in his iniquity.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
public_domain_references.brenton: But they that escape of them shall be delivered, and shall be upon the mountains: and I will slay all [the rest], every one for his iniquities.

pob.text: All hands will grow weak[a], and all knees will run with water.

spob.text: Everyone’s hands will go limp, and their knees will give way as water runs down them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.
public_domain_references.web: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.
public_domain_references.asv: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
public_domain_references.kjv: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak [as] water.
public_domain_references.brenton: All hands shall be completely weakened, and all thighs shall be defiled with moisture.

pob.text: They will put on sackcloth, and horror will cover them; shame will be on every face, and baldness on all their heads.

spob.text: They will put on rough clothes of mourning.[a] Horror will cover them. Shame will show on every face, and every head will be bald.

public_domain_references.bsb: They will put on sackcloth, and terror will overwhelm them. Shame will cover all their faces, and all their heads will be shaved.
public_domain_references.web: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
public_domain_references.asv: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
public_domain_references.kjv: They shall also gird [themselves] with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame [shall be] upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall gird themselves with sackcloth, and amazement shall cover them; and shame shall be upon them, [even] upon every face, and baldness upon every head.

pob.text: They will throw their silver into the streets[a], and their gold will become an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold will not be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath. They will not satisfy their appetite, nor fill their stomachs, for it has become the stumbling block of their iniquity.

spob.text: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will become something unclean.[a] Their silver and gold will not be able to rescue them on the day of Yahweh’s wrath. Their wealth will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs, because it became a stumbling block that led them into sin.

public_domain_references.bsb: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will seem unclean. Their silver and gold cannot save them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their appetites or fill their stomachs with wealth, for it became the stumbling block that brought their iniquity.
public_domain_references.web: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. public_domain_references.asv: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of Jehovah: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels; because it hath been the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
public_domain_references.kjv: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
public_domain_references.brenton: Their silver shall be cast forth in the streets, and their gold shall be despised: their souls shall not be satisfied, and their bellies shall not be filled: for it was the punishment of their iniquities.

pob.text: And they made the beauty of his ornament into pride[a], and in it they made the images of their abominations, their detestable things[b]; therefore I have made it an unclean thing to them.

spob.text: They turned his beautiful ornament into a source of pride. In it[a] they made images of their abhorrent things, their detestable things. Therefore, I made it an unclean thing for them.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images and detestable idols. Therefore I will make these into something unclean for them.
public_domain_references.web: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.
public_domain_references.asv: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations [and] their detestable things therein: therefore have I made it unto them as an unclean thing.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations [and] of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
public_domain_references.brenton: [As for] their choice ornaments, they employed them for pride, and they made of them images of their abominations: therefore have I made them uncleanness to them.

pob.text: And I will give it into the hand of foreigners for plunder[a], and to the wicked of the earth for spoil[b], and they will profane it.

spob.text: I will hand it over to foreigners as plunder and to the wicked of the earth[a] as spoil. They will profane it—treating what is holy as common.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: And I will hand these things over as plunder to foreigners and loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile them.
public_domain_references.web: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall profane it.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will deliver them into the hands of strangers to make them a prey, and to the pests of the earth for a spoil; and they shall profane them.

pob.text: I will turn my face away from them[a], and they will profane my treasured place[b]; violent men will enter it and profane it.

spob.text: I will turn my face away from them. They will desecrate my treasured place,[a] and violent men[b] will enter it and desecrate it.

public_domain_references.bsb: I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My treasured place. Violent men will enter it, and they will defile it.
public_domain_references.web: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.
public_domain_references.asv: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall profane my secret [place]; and robbers shall enter into it, and profane it.
public_domain_references.kjv: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret [place:] for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will turn away my face from them, and they shall defile my charge, and shall go in to them unguardedly, and profane them.

pob.text: Make the chain[a], for the land is full of bloody crimes[b], and the city is full of violence.

spob.text: Make the chain[a], because the land is full of crimes involving bloodshed[b], and the city is full of violence.

public_domain_references.bsb: Forge the chain, for the land is full of crimes of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
public_domain_references.web: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
public_domain_references.asv: Make the chain; for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall work uncleanness: because the land is full of strange nations, and the city is full of iniquity.

pob.text: And I will bring the worst of the nations[a], and they will take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the strong[c][b], and their sanctuaries will be profaned.

spob.text: I will bring the worst of the nations,[a] and they will take over their homes.[b] I will put an end to the pride of the powerful, and their holy places will be treated as unholy.

public_domain_references.bsb: So I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will end the pride of the mighty, and their holy places will be profaned.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.
public_domain_references.asv: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pride of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be profaned.
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will turn back the boasting of their strength; and their holy things shall be defiled.

pob.text: Anguish has come[a], and they will seek peace, but there is none.

spob.text: Now anguish is here.[a] They will search for peace, but there is no peace.

public_domain_references.bsb: Anguish is coming! They will seek peace, but find none.
public_domain_references.web: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.
public_domain_references.asv: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
public_domain_references.kjv: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and [there shall be] none.
public_domain_references.brenton: And [though] propitiation shall come, and [one] shall seek peace, yet there shall be none.

pob.text: Disaster upon disaster will come[a], and rumor upon rumor will arise. They will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction will perish from the priest[b], and counsel from the elders.

spob.text: Disaster will follow disaster, and rumor after rumor[a] will spread. They will seek a vision from a prophet, but the priest’s instruction[b] will disappear, and so will the elders’ counsel.

public_domain_references.bsb: Disaster upon disaster will come, and rumor after rumor. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction from the priests will perish, as will counsel from the elders.
public_domain_references.web: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
public_domain_references.asv: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumor shall be upon rumor; and they shall seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
public_domain_references.kjv: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
public_domain_references.brenton: There shall be woe upon woe, and there shall be message upon message; and a vision shall be sought from a prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

pob.text: The king will mourn[a], and the prince will clothe himself with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. According to their way I will deal with them, and by their own judgments I will judge them[c][b]. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and I will judge them by their own standards. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
public_domain_references.web: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
public_domain_references.asv: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: The prince shall clothe himself with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be made feeble: I will do to them according to their ways, and according to their judgments will I punish them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

pob.text: And it happened in the sixth year[a], in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me[b], that the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me there.

spob.text: On the fifth day of the sixth month in the sixth year, I was sitting in my house. The elders of Judah were sitting in front of me. The hand of the Lord Yahweh[a] fell upon me there.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me; and there the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me.
public_domain_references.web: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord Yahweh’s hand fell on me there.
public_domain_references.asv: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord Jehovah fell there upon me.
public_domain_references.kjv: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, [as] I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth [day] of the month, I was sitting in the house, and the elders of Juda were sitting before me: and the hand of the Lord came upon me.

pob.text: Then I looked[a], and behold, a form with the appearance of fire: from what appeared to be his waist and downward, fire; and from his waist and upward, like the appearance of brightness, like gleaming amber.

spob.text: Then I looked, and there before me was a figure that looked like fire. Below what seemed to be his waist was fire. Above his waist it looked like a bright glow, like gleaming amber.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then I looked and saw a figure like that of a man. From His waist down His appearance was like fire, and from His waist up He was as bright as the gleam of amber.
